# helm_release (Resource)

_Helm_ release TF resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "helm_release" "example" {
  chart     = "oci://ghcr.io/fluent/helm-charts/fluent-bit-aggregator"
  name      = "fluent-bit-aggregator"
  namespace = "logging"
  version   = "1.0.2"

  values = {}

  timeouts = {
    create = "10m"
    update = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chart` (String) The _Helm_ chart to install.
- `name` (String) The _Helm_ release name.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace to install the _Helm_ chart into.
- `values` (Dynamic) Values for the _Helm_ chart.
- `version` (String) The _Helm_ chart version to install.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `manifests` (Dynamic) Manifests that were created by the _Helm_ chart.
- `status` (String) The status of the _Helm_ release.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for creating the resource; this defaults to the provider value if not set. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).
